Terms of service

The basic terms for using this website and working with Jemawe.

Draft terms

This summary is not a binding contract. Terms for paid work are supplied in a written agreement and need review before use.

Using this website

The information on this website describes our services in general terms. It is not an offer or a guarantee of availability, price, or results for any specific job.

Quotes and agreements

Work begins only after you approve a written scope and quote. That written agreement, not this website, sets out what is included, the price, the timeline, and payment terms. Changes to scope are quoted and approved before they are carried out.

Remote IT support

  • Every remote session requires your explicit permission at the time of the session.
  • You can end a session at any time.
  • We will not ask for your passwords, and you remain responsible for your accounts.
  • You confirm you are authorized to allow access to the device.

Computer repairs and upgrades

  • A diagnosis comes first. We then provide a quote listing parts and labor separately.
  • No repair is carried out without your approval of the quote.
  • Final pricing and availability depend on the diagnosis and on part availability and compatibility.
  • You are responsible for backing up your data before handing over a device. We take care, but cannot guarantee data on failing hardware.

Any diagnostic fee, repair warranty, and collection arrangement will be stated in the written quote or agreement for your device.

Websites and software

Ownership of designs, code, and content, hosting responsibilities, and maintenance terms are set out in each project agreement.

Third-party services

Some solutions use third-party services such as hosting, domains, booking, or payment providers. Their own terms and fees apply, and they are billed separately from our work.

Contact

Questions about these terms can be sent through the contact page.
